introHtml: Hartmann garment bags combine the brand's heritage of durable, refined luggage construction with custom branding for corporate travel programs, retail staff, or executive gifts. These bags protect suits and dresses during transport while presenting your logo on a trusted, high-end product. Choose from various sizes and interior configurations to match your team's travel needs, with embroidery or screen printing for a professional finish.
